name: Haus Sonnwend Komfortappartements
beschreibung: The Haus Sonnwend Komfortappartements is located on peaceful Wochenbrunnweg on the outskirts of Ellmau in Tyrol's renowned Wilder Kaiser holiday region. These modern, tastefully furnished comfort apartments offer an exceptional stay, complete with fully equipped kitchenettes, inviting living areas, restful bedrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing unobstructed vistas of the craggy Wilder Kaiser massif. Ellmau's charming village centre with its bakeries and restaurants is an easy walk away. In winter, the ski bus stops nearby, whisking visitors to the Hartkaiserbahn gondola and into the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental. In summer, scenic paths up towards the Wochenbrunner Alm and themed hiking trails begin right at the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Comfortable holiday apartments on Wochenbrunnweg in Ellmau at the Wilder Kaiser with kitchenettes and direct Kaisergebirge views.
